run_audio_captioning: run the audio captioning pipeline to generate optimized captions for audio files using ImageBind and LLM
optimize_audio_captions: optimize audio captions by iteratively scoring and refining text descriptions against audio features
run_clip_scorer: run the clip scorer to compute similarity scores between text captions and audio embeddings
format_examples: format example sentences for the LLM generator by sampling from the initial description pool
parse_args_audio_captioning: parse command line arguments for the audio captioning pipeline including model and batch settings
